Me fui cargue en la rotonda y cuando pase por allj ya estaban vendiendo
No entendí el mal trato y menos lo descortés

I went there a couple of weeks ago and a gas station employee really mistreated me. He told me there was no fuel, that the tanker truck was coming and it would take at least an hour... there was a marathon of Colombian gas stations.
I left, filled up at the roundabout, and when I passed by there they were already selling gas. I didn't understand the bad treatment, much less the rudeness.
